talents.description: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 3.

talents.name: Improved Tactical Mastery
talents.description: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

talents.name: Improved Thunder Clap
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 6.

talents.name: Improved Overpower
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%.

talents.name: Anger Management
talents.description: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

talents.name: Deep Wounds
talents.description: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 0% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
talents.description: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%.

talents.name: Impale
talents.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%.

talents.name: Weaponmaster
talents.description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Axes and Polearms by 1%.

talents.name: Weaponmaster
talents.description: Your attacks with Maces and Staves ignore 15% of your target's armor.

talents.name: Weaponmaster
talents.description: Gives you a 0% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after dealing damage with your Sword.

talents.name: Improved Hamstring
talents.description: Gives your Hamstring ability a 0% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Mortal Strike
talents.description: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Booming Voice
talents.description: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 50% and reduces their Rage cost by 25%.

talents.name: Cruelty
talents.description: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

talents.name: Improved Demoralizing Shout
talents.description: Increases the melee attack power reduction of your Demoralizing Shout by 8%.

talents.name: Unbridled Wrath
talents.description: Gives you a 0% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

talents.name: Improved Cleave
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by -3.

talents.name: Blood Craze
talents.description: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

talents.name: Improved Battle Shout
talents.description: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Battle Shout by 5%.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 5%.

talents.name: Improved Execute
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 5.

talents.name: Improved Slam
talents.description: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by -0.5 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by -3 sec.

talents.name: Death Wish
talents.description: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Improved Intercept
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 10 sec.

talents.name: Improved Berserker Rage
talents.description: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

talents.name: Bloodthirst
talents.description: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
talents.description: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

talents.name: Anticipation
talents.description: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.

talents.name: Improved Bloodrage
talents.description: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

talents.name: Toughness
talents.description: Increases your Armor value from items by 10%.

talents.name: Last Stand
talents.description: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

talents.name: Improved Shield Block
talents.description: Allows your Shield Block ability to block an additional attack and increases the duration by 0.5 second.

talents.name: Improved Revenge
talents.description: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.

talents.name: Improved Sunder Armor
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 3.

talents.name: Improved Disarm
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 secs.

talents.name: Improved Taunt
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Taunt ability by 1 sec.

talents.name: Improved Shield Wall
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by -11 min.

talents.name: Concussion Blow
talents.description: Stuns the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Improved Shield Bash
talents.description: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Bastion
talents.description: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.

talents.name: Shield Slam
talents.description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 430 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

Human.name: Ruthless
Human.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2%.

Human.name: Perception
Human.description: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

Orc.name: Blood Fury
Orc.description: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

Orc.name: Hardiness
Orc.description: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

Orc.name: Savage
Orc.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1%.

Orc.name: Shatter Curse
Orc.description: Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

Dwarf.name: Stoneform
Dwarf.description: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

Dwarf.name: Earth Fury
Dwarf.description: Increases your critical strike bonus to damage and healing by 2%.

Dwarf.name: Big Game Hunter
Dwarf.description: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

Night Elf.name: Shadowmeld
Night Elf.description: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

Night Elf.name: Quickness
Night Elf.description: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

Night Elf.name: Wisp Spirit
Night Elf.description: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

Night Elf.name: Elune's Light
Night Elf.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

Undead.name: Underwater Breathing
Undead.description: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

Undead.name: Will of the Forsaken
Undead.description: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

Undead.name: Cannibalize
Undead.description: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

Tauren.name: Endurance
Tauren.description: Total Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%.

Tauren.name: Cultivation
Tauren.description: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.

Tauren.name: Plainsrunning
Tauren.description: Gain 1% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 30% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect. In addition, you move 3% faster while mounted.

Gnome.name: Escape Artist
Gnome.description: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

Gnome.name: Engineering Specialization
Gnome.description: Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.

Gnome.name: Eureka!
Gnome.description: Your non-periodic damaging abilities have their Energy cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec.

Troll.name: Regeneration
Troll.description: Health regeneration rate increased by 20%. In addition, 20% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.

Troll.name: Beast Slaying
Troll.description: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

Troll.name: Rapid Regeneration
Troll.description: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

High Order Skyborne.description: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

High Order Skyborne.name: Read Leyline
High Order Skyborne.description: Attempt to tap into the power of a nearby leyline, increasing your Health and Mana regeneration by 100%. Lasts 30 sec if no leyline is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

High Order Skyborne.name: Elemental Insight
High Order Skyborne.description: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

High Order Skyborne.name: Wind Blessed
High Order Skyborne.description: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 3%.

Windshaper Skyborne.name: Skysight
Windshaper Skyborne.description: Attempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement and mounted movement speeds by 10%. Lasts 30 sec if no elemental convergence is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.
